self.title: What Makes a Physical Memory Worth Its Energy Cost?

detail.title: Thermodynamic Costs of Memory Reliability
detail.question: How do energy costs scale with reliability and retention time in physical memory systems?
detail.reason: Attention constraints require transitioning to the 'thermodynamic_memory' topic. This project addresses the foundational question of memory energy cost-reliability trade-offs.

detail.title: Thermodynamic Costs of Memory States
detail.question: What is the relationship between the number of memory states required for optimal prediction and the thermodynamic work production or dissipation of an information engine?
detail.reason: Existing evidence connects memory states to work production in information engines; clarifying this link is central to the project's domain.
